introduction: The skill render turns one source tree under skills/ into the three af-* skills for each of four coding agents. It reads a skill as a SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter and a body, resolves the reference files the skill links, keeps only the frontmatter keys the agent reads, replaces the one {{invoke}} token with that agent's invocation syntax, and refuses a skill whose body would load more than 24,576 bytes at once. make skills writes the output under build/skills/, make install-skills copies it into an agent's skill directory, and make check runs the render's checks with no network and no credential.

glossary.<source path>: <problem>: The one line the skill render writes to stderr for each problem it finds: the path of the source file, a colon and a space, then the problem in words. Every refusal of the render takes this form, and a warning takes it too.
glossary.agent: One of the four coding agents the render targets: claude, codex, cursor and copilot. Each reads its own frontmatter keys and its own invocation syntax.
glossary.body: The part of a SKILL.md that follows the line closing its YAML frontmatter. It is loaded with the skill, which is why it carries the ceiling.
glossary.reference file: A Markdown file under a skill's own references/ or under skills/_shared/references/, read by the agent at the step that links it rather than loaded with the skill.
glossary.skill: A directory directly under skills/ whose name does not begin with an underscore, holding a SKILL.md and optionally its own references/ directory.
glossary.skill render: The program make runs to render, install and uninstall the skills.

requirements.title: The skill source tree
requirements.rationale: One source tree serves four agents only if the render agrees with the author on what a skill is and on which files belong to it.

criteria.action: treat every directory directly under skills/ whose name does not begin with an underscore as a skill, and read its SKILL.md as YAML frontmatter delimited by two --- lines followed by the body

criteria.condition: a SKILL.md or an included reference file links references/<file>.md
criteria.action: resolve <file>.md in the linking skill's own skills/<name>/references/ first and in skills/_shared/references/ second
criteria.contract: the resolved file is written into that skill's output as references/<file>.md

criteria.action: for any skill, include a reference file when that skill's SKILL.md links it or when a reference file already included in that skill links it, and include no other file

criteria.condition: a link to references/<file>.md resolves in neither the linking skill's own references/ nor skills/_shared/references/
criteria.action: report the problem and render nothing
criteria.contract: stderr carries one line reading `skills/af-spec/SKILL.md: links references/tasks.md, which is in neither skills/af-spec/references/ nor skills/_shared/references/`; the exit code is non-zero

criteria.condition: a reference file name is present both in a skill's own references/ and in skills/_shared/references/
criteria.action: report the problem naming the file and both directories, and render nothing
criteria.contract: stderr carries one line of the form `<source path>: <problem>` naming the file and both directories; the exit code is non-zero; no file is written for any agent

criteria.condition: a skill directory holds no SKILL.md, or its SKILL.md has no frontmatter, or its frontmatter is not YAML
criteria.action: report which of the three it is and render nothing
criteria.contract: stderr carries one line of the form `<source path>: <problem>` naming which of the three it is; the exit code is non-zero; no file is written for any agent

requirements.title: Rendering a skill for an agent
requirements.rationale: An installed skill has to work in its agent with no edit, and a render nobody can rerun with the same result is a render nobody can check.

criteria.condition: make skills runs over a source tree that holds no problem
criteria.action: write build/skills/<agent>/<name>/SKILL.md and its references/ directory for each of the agents claude, codex, cursor and copilot and each skill under skills/
criteria.contract: exit code 0; build/skills/<agent>/<name>/SKILL.md exists for all four agents and every skill, each with a references/ holding exactly that skill's included files

criteria.action: keep in a rendered frontmatter only the keys the agent reads — name, description, argument-hint and disable-model-invocation for claude; name and description for codex; name, description and disable-model-invocation for cursor; name and description for copilot — in the order the source gives them, each kept key carrying its source text and its continuation lines unchanged
replace every {{invoke <name>}} in a body or a reference file with /<name> for claude, cursor and copilot and with $<name> for codex, and change no other byte of the body or of any reference file
for any source tree that has not changed, write byte-identical output on every run

criteria.condition: make skills runs over a source tree from which a file has been removed since the previous run
criteria.action: replace the previous output of make skills whole
criteria.contract: build/skills/ holds no file that the current source does not render; exit code 0

criteria.action: render without making a model call, without making a network call, without reading a credential and without running the update-agentkit target

requirements.title: A skill's name and description
requirements.rationale: Every one of the four agents loads a skill by its directory and offers it by its description, so a name or a description that breaks the Agent Skills rule breaks the skill in the agent, not in the render.

criteria.condition: a frontmatter has no name, a name that differs from its directory's name, or a name that is not 1 to 64 characters of lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens with neither the first nor the last character a hyphen
criteria.action: report the rule broken and render nothing
criteria.contract: stderr carries one line of the form `<source path>: <problem>` naming the rule broken; the exit code is non-zero; no file is written for any agent

criteria.condition: a frontmatter has no description, an empty description, or a description longer than 1,024 characters
criteria.action: report which of the three it is and render nothing
criteria.contract: stderr carries one line of the form `<source path>: <problem>`; a description of exactly 1,024 characters is accepted; the exit code is non-zero; no file is written for any agent

requirements.title: The body ceiling
requirements.rationale: The body is what loads with the skill at every step of a run, so it is the only part whose size the render has to hold down.

criteria.condition: a rendered body is longer than 24,576 bytes for any agent
criteria.action: report the skill, the agent, the size and the overage, and render nothing
criteria.contract: stderr carries one line reading `skills/af-spec/SKILL.md: body is 31,204 bytes for codex, 6,628 over the 24,576-byte limit`; the exit code is non-zero; no file is written for any agent

criteria.action: measure a rendered body as the bytes of UTF-8 that follow the line closing the frontmatter, after {{invoke <name>}} has been replaced for that agent, and accept a body of exactly 24,576 bytes
render a reference file of any size without reporting a problem about its size

requirements.title: Tokens and agent-specific text
requirements.rationale: The one text that differs by agent is the invocation of another skill; any other agent-specific text in the source is a skill that works in one agent and not the next.

criteria.condition: a {{invoke <name>}} token names no directory under skills/
criteria.action: report the source file and the unknown name, and render nothing
criteria.contract: stderr carries one line of the form `<source path>: <problem>` naming the unknown skill; the exit code is non-zero; no file is written for any agent

criteria.condition: a body or a reference file holds a {{...}} token that is not {{invoke <name>}}
criteria.action: report the source file and the token, and render nothing
criteria.contract: stderr carries one line of the form `<source path>: <problem>` naming the token; the exit code is non-zero; no file is written for any agent

criteria.condition: a body or a reference file holds $ARGUMENTS, or holds /<name> or $<name> for a skill under skills/ where the character before it is the start of a line, whitespace or one of a backtick, an opening parenthesis, an opening bracket or a double quote and the character after it is the end of a line, whitespace or punctuation
criteria.action: report the source file and the text found, and render nothing
criteria.contract: stderr carries one line of the form `<source path>: <problem>` naming the text found and {{invoke <name>}} as its replacement; the exit code is non-zero; the path skills/af-impl written in prose is not reported

requirements.title: Reporting problems and warnings
requirements.rationale: An author fixing the source wants every problem of one run, not the first of five; and a reference file nobody links is worth a word but not a stopped build.

criteria.action: report every problem the source tree holds in one run, one problem to a line on stderr in the form `<source path>: <problem>`

criteria.condition: the source tree holds at least one problem
criteria.action: exit non-zero and write no file for any agent
criteria.contract: the exit code is non-zero; build/skills/ is left exactly as it was before the run

criteria.condition: a file in a skill's own references/ is linked by nothing
criteria.action: write a warning to stderr naming the file and leave the exit code 0
criteria.contract: stderr carries one line reading `skills/af-impl/references/old.md: linked by nothing; not rendered`; the exit code is 0; the file is in no agent's output

criteria.condition: a file in skills/_shared/references/ is linked by no skill
criteria.action: write a warning to stderr naming the file and leave the exit code 0
criteria.contract: stderr carries one line naming the file as linked by nothing; the exit code is 0; the file is in no agent's output

requirements.title: Installing a rendered skill
requirements.rationale: A skill reaches an agent only from that agent's own directory, and a user installing again after a source file was removed should not be left with it.

criteria.condition: make install-skills runs with no AGENT
criteria.action: render the skills for claude and copy each one into the claude user skill directory
criteria.contract: exit code 0; ~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md and ~/.claude/skills/<name>/references/ exist for each skill

criteria.action: resolve the install directory as SKILLS_DIR when SKILLS_DIR is given; else, when PROJECT is given, as <PROJECT>/.claude/skills for claude, <PROJECT>/.agents/skills for codex, <PROJECT>/.cursor/skills for cursor and <PROJECT>/.github/skills for copilot; else as ~/.claude/skills for claude, $CODEX_HOME/skills for codex or ~/.codex/skills when CODEX_HOME is unset, ~/.cursor/skills for cursor and ~/.copilot/skills for copilot

criteria.condition: the skills are installed
criteria.action: print one line reading `installed: <name> -> <dir>/<name>` for each skill and exit 0
criteria.contract: stdout carries one such line per skill; the exit code is 0

criteria.action: replace <dir>/<name>/ whole for each skill installed, leaving behind no file of a previous install, and add, change or remove no other entry under <dir>

criteria.condition: the source tree holds at least one problem when an install is asked for
criteria.action: install nothing, report the problems as make skills does, and exit non-zero
criteria.contract: the exit code is non-zero; stderr carries one line per problem; <dir> is left exactly as it was

criteria.condition: AGENT is a value other than claude, codex, cursor or copilot
criteria.action: report the value with the four it accepts and write nothing
criteria.contract: stderr carries `unknown agent "<value>"; one of: claude, codex, cursor, copilot`; the exit code is non-zero; <dir> is left exactly as it was

criteria.condition: PROJECT is given and is not an existing directory
criteria.action: report the path and write nothing
criteria.contract: stderr carries `PROJECT <path> is not a directory`; the exit code is non-zero; no file is written anywhere

criteria.condition: the agent also loads another directory that already holds a skill of the name being installed
criteria.action: print the warning naming that directory and install all the same
criteria.contract: stderr carries `warning: <agent> also loads <path>/<name>; it will see <name> twice`; the exit code is 0; <dir>/<name> holds the installed skill

requirements.title: Uninstalling the skills
requirements.rationale: An uninstall that resolved its directory differently from the install, or that removed more than it installed, would take someone else's skills with it.

criteria.condition: make uninstall-skills runs
criteria.action: resolve the directory by the same rule as the install and remove <dir>/<name> for each of af-prd, af-spec and af-impl, printing `removed: <name>` for each one it removed
criteria.contract: exit code 0; stdout carries one line per removed skill; <dir>/<name> no longer exists for each of the three

criteria.action: skip a skill name that <dir> does not hold, writing no line for it and leaving the exit code 0
remove no entry under <dir> other than the directories named af-prd, af-spec and af-impl

requirements.title: The committed source tree
requirements.rationale: The render's rules are worth nothing if the repository's own three skills break them; this is the one criterion the split has to satisfy.

criteria.action: render every skill of the repository's own skills/ tree for claude, codex, cursor and copilot without reporting a problem
criteria.contract: exit code 0 and no line on stderr of the form `<source path>: <problem>`

requirements.title: The build's targets
requirements.rationale: The ceiling and the link rules hold only if the check someone runs before committing is the one that enforces them.

criteria.condition: make check runs
criteria.action: run the render's checks after test, making no network call and reading no API key
criteria.contract: the exit code is 0 when the source tree holds no problem and non-zero when it holds one, with the problems on stderr; no request leaves the machine

criteria.action: list skills, skills-check, install-skills and uninstall-skills in the output of make help

criteria.condition: make clean runs
criteria.action: remove build/skills with the rest of build/
criteria.contract: build/ does not exist; the exit code is 0

execution_paths.title: A maintainer renders every skill for every agent

steps.action: runs make skills in a checkout
reads every skill directory under skills/ and resolves the reference files each one links, its own first and the shared ones second
checks every skill against the render rules for claude, codex, cursor and copilot
writes build/skills/<agent>/<name>/SKILL.md and its references/ for each agent and skill, replacing any previous output whole
reads build/skills/codex/af-spec/SKILL.md and finds only name and description in its frontmatter and $af-impl where the source held {{invoke af-impl}}

execution_paths.title: A maintainer installs the skills into a repository and removes them again

steps.action: runs make install-skills AGENT=codex PROJECT=<path> against a scratch repository
resolves the install directory as <path>/.agents/skills and renders the skills for codex
replaces <path>/.agents/skills/<name>/ whole for each skill and prints installed: <name> -> <path>/.agents/skills/<name>
removes the three skill directories, prints removed: <name> for each, and leaves every other entry under <path>/.agents/skills in place

execution_paths.title: A maintainer sees the render's checks refuse a skill that breaks a rule

steps.action: adds a link to a reference file that does not exist and a body over the ceiling, then runs make skills-check
collects every problem the source tree holds rather than stopping at the first
writes one line per problem to stderr, each naming the source file and the rule, and exits non-zero without writing an output tree
reads the two problems named, finds build/skills/ unchanged, and sees make check fail on the same checks because it runs skills-check after test
